data.name: activity_log_pending_sync_index
data.sql: CREATE INDEX activity_log_pending_sync_index ON activity_log (entity_table) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND sync_acknowledged_at IS NULL AND after_image IS NOT NULL

data.name: template_exercises_active_exercise_unique
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX template_exercises_active_exercise_unique ON template_exercises (workout_template_id, exercise_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

data.name: template_group_members_active_exercise_unique
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX template_group_members_active_exercise_unique ON template_group_members (template_exercise_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focuses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "library_origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_load_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kilogram', "load_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'added', "record_profile" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'repMax', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_unilateral" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_unilateral" IN (0, 1)), "uses_rpe" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uses_rpe" IN (0, 1)), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "equipment_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "focus_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01', "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "focus_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01', "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "nutrient_values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_liquid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_liquid" IN (0, 1)), "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_size" REAL NULL, "package_size" REAL NULL, "recipe_ingredients_json" TEXT NULL, "recipe_serving_count" REAL NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id), "entry_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quickEntry', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutrient_values_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "portion_json" TEXT NULL, "food_source" TEXT NULL, "is_liquid" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_liquid" IN (0, 1)), "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_size" REAL NULL, "package_size" REAL NULL, "import_source" TEXT NULL, "import_external_id" TEXT NULL, "import_provider" TEXT NULL, "review_flags_json" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutrient_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_value" REAL NOT NULL, "target_entered" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_groups (id), "workout_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "logged_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_rest_after" INTEGER NULL, "performed_at" INTEGER NULL, "load_value" REAL NULL, "load_unit" TEXT NULL, "load_entered" TEXT NULL, "reps_value" REAL NULL, "reps_unit" TEXT NULL, "reps_entered" TEXT NULL, "duration_value" REAL NULL, "duration_unit" TEXT NULL, "duration_entered" TEXT NULL, "distance_value" REAL NULL, "distance_unit" TEXT NULL, "distance_entered" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "side" TEXT NULL, "rpe" REAL NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rest_timers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "source_set_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES logged_sets (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deadline_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "alert_volume" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', "alert_fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "prepare_alert_fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interval_timers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "phase_started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deadline_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_step_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_set_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "alert_volume" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'work', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', "prepare_alert_fired_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_image" TEXT NULL, "after_image" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_acknowledged_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pull_cursor" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle', "last_successful_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "first_failure_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_failure_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_failure_message" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deferred_sync_changes" ("entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "change_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deferred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_table", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quarantined_sync_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "change_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "failure_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quarantined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_value" REAL NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "measurement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurements (id), "value" REAL NOT NULL, "value_entered" TEXT NOT NULL, "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "metrics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_shape" TEXT NOT NULL, "metric_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NULL, "goal_target_value" REAL NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "metric_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metric_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES metrics (id), "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "scalar_value" REAL NULL, "scalar_entered" TEXT NULL, "at_time" INTEGER NULL, "window_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "window_ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compounds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_route" TEXT NOT NULL, "strength" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "compound_id" TEXT NULL, "compound_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "compound_strength" TEXT NULL, "amount_value" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_entered" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "route" TEXT NOT NULL, "took_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01', "timezone_offset_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "protocol_id" TEXT NULL, "protocol_name" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocols" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_local_date" TEXT NULL, "period" TEXT NULL, "reminders_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminders_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "archived_on" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol_compounds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES protocols (id), "compound_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES compounds (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_on" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_compound_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES protocol_compounds (id), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose_amount_value" REAL NULL, "dose_amount_entered" TEXT NULL, "dose_unit" TEXT NULL, "route" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol_target_outcomes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES protocols (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "metric_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES metrics (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "monitoring_series_cache" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "encoding" TEXT NOT NULL, "compression" TEXT NOT NULL, "blob" BLOB NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "integration_data_class_consents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "credential_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "theme_preference" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_system" TEXT NOT NULL, "week_start_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_weight_increment" REAL NOT NULL, "home_screen_display" TEXT NOT NULL, "pr_tracking_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pr_tracking_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "mark_sets_complete_by_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("mark_sets_complete_by_default" IN (0, 1)), "auto_select_next_set" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_select_next_set" IN (0, 1)), "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "focus_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "rounds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (rounds >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_groups (id), "template_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prescriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_exercises (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "rest_after" INTEGER NULL, "load_value" REAL NULL, "load_unit" TEXT NULL, "load_entered" TEXT NULL, "reps_value" REAL NULL, "reps_unit" TEXT NULL, "reps_entered" TEXT NULL, "duration_value" REAL NULL, "duration_unit" TEXT NULL, "duration_entered" TEXT NULL, "distance_value" REAL NULL, "distance_unit" TEXT NULL, "distance_entered" TEXT NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cadence_kind" TEXT NULL, "cadence_window" INTEGER NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "workout_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "routine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES plan_routines (id), "slot" INTEGER NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_routines (id), "workout_template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot" INTEGER NULL, "sync_device_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_previously_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_previously_synced" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE INDEX protocol_compounds_compound_id_index ON protocol_compounds (compound_id)
